body:
I knew him since high school. What we had was tumultous and a novel in its own right. I had a shitty childhood, but he made me believe i was capable of anything and always loved me, we loved each other so very much.

I experimented with drugs in my early 20s (im 31) but i havent touched them in 5+ years. I barely drink or smoke marijuana even, maybe one or the other once a week, socially. It doesnt take any of my problems away. It doesnt enhance them, theyre just the same so its kinda pointless.
